purpose: Functional browser checks with synthetic records and injected faults; not the 90-run thesis evaluation.

tests.name: Encrypted persistence, locked views, and wrong-passphrase rejection
Atomic save failure never reports success or creates a queue entry
Lost response after server commit retries the same ID without duplicate insertion
Restart recovers persisted IN_FLIGHT entries and uploads them
Corrupt ciphertext is retained and blocked while other records synchronize
Unverified server receipt cannot mark a local record acknowledged
Failed local acknowledgement commit retains the record for safe recovery
Unauthorized uploads pause without losing data and resume with valid credentials
Repeated synchronization triggers never start overlapping requests
Browser offline reload preserves the encrypted queue and cached app shell
Desktop and mobile app layouts remain usable without uncaught script errors
Two workers sharing one vault serialize requests with the browser lock
Retry-After survives recovery and cannot be bypassed by repeated triggers
Lock cancels an unlock already waiting for local configuration
An IV collision including the key-check IV retries encryption atomically
Actual upload timeout retains the entry and recovery ignores an incorrect online hint
